findings.title: Reject nonfinite or malformed report values before certifying complete replay
findings.detail: aggregate checks 13 guard values, but never checks budget_q or regional RMS for finiteness. Python json.loads admits NaN; NaN > eta is false. An artificial replay receipt with budget_q=NaN or strain_background.error_RMS=NaN is accepted and writes COMPARATIVE_FIELD_REPLAY_COMPLETE_NOT_APPLICATION_VALIDATION plus a NaN-containing CSV. The aggregate entry is therefore not fail-closed against unreadable physical budget/metric evidence.
findings.required_change: Validate the complete consumed physical-report schema and numeric domain before comparison/output. Reject NaN/Infinity and malformed q/components/region metrics; recompute q/ceiling consistency from recorded component integrals and immutable origin scales, handling explicit zero-scale semantics. Add negative tests proving no summary/complete receipt is emitted.

findings.title: Bind replay evidence and enforce coherent integer compute counts
findings.detail: aggregate trusts replayed_solvers/replayed_trials without nonnegative-integer or per-profile-sum checks, and ignores code_tree_sha256. Artificial receipts with -100 solves/-10 trials per state, fractional totals, profile counts 999 with aggregate counts zero, or a wrong code-tree hash all receive a complete verdict. Replay also does not bind its result to a hash of the numeric receipt/input manifest; matching source_commit text alone is insufficient to detect stale/mixed evidence.
findings.required_change: Validate exact state/profile schema/order; nonnegative integer per-profile and total counts within 3 solves/27 trials per profile, 12/108 per state and 36/324 total; require totals to equal profile sums and validated stop/accepted-step structure. Bind numeric and replay records to the current reviewed code tree and immutable numeric receipt/input-manifest hashes; verify those links before aggregate completion. Add malformed/stale-identity/count tests.

findings.title: Persist and replay branch-change diagnostics for every visited trial
findings.detail: The frozen plan line105 requires branch changes for every visited candidate. Trial events store coefficients, guards/Q, gains, mapping and timing, but no tensile/compressive GP branch-change diagnostic. physical_report computes branch_changed_GP_fraction only for original/final/historical reports, leaving rejected/intermediate visited heads without the required saved branch evidence.
findings.required_change: Emit a compact actual-field branch-change diagnostic for every visited quantized trial, including rejected trials, relative to the declared fixed origin (and current iterate if useful). Recompute and check it during no-optimizer replay; include a synthetic branch-changing rejected trial and tamper test. No extra real candidate or scientific computation is needed.

limitations: No real endpoint, reference archive or D012 scientific payload was loaded.
True conditioning, physical gains, production-scale cost and cross-platform bit replay remain unmeasured.
No claim of scientific success or application/teacher/history validity.
